notes.title: Onslaught is out of early access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780659/fb511ecbea26f3dd43816206e36a4c2cfd95f15d.png[/img]

Here is the finial update/Change log of the game, if there is a bug or an error please post on the discord support section for Onslaught: Armoured Assault

---------- Update 1.4.0 (Full Release) ----------
Changes
- Updated from unity 2018 -> 2019
- Rewrote majority of the scripts to give better performance
- Removed Temp art.
- Removed Broken assets no longer used
- Changed Intro Text
- Changed Changelog screen
- Removed Localisation.
- Removed Temp scripts from ships due to help with performance
- Updated all unity package to remove bugs and glitches
- Changed All values of the ships to create some better balance
- Changed base stats of all the additional structures to balance better
- Game is now in maintenance mode.

Fixes
- Intro screen disappearing bug
- Fixed Ui from not scaling correctly
- Fixed bullets from not colliding with ships on an occasion
- Fixed turrets running more targeting attempts, Helps with performance
- Fixed turrets Update function to be more performant
- Fixed Ui text leaving boxes
- Fixed Structures from having extra stats based on difficulty.
- Fixed the equation for the difficulty scaling
- Fixed text sharpness, Upgraded most of the text from unity’s default to TextMeshPro.

Additions
- Added in new pirate ship battle cruiser

ADDED IN CHEATS
Access console with ` Key
- Generic Command: version – displays version
- Generic Command: fps – gives current fps
- Generic Command: quit – quits the game

- Game Cheat: gm_pirateLeader – spawns pirate leader ship.
- Game Cheat: gm_startPirateWave – Starts pirate wave.
- Game Cheat: gm_kill – Kills your main base
- Game Cheat: gm_startRandom – Starts random event
- Game Cheat: gm_startwave – starts wave invasion


- Cheat: c_bigdaddy – Spawns dreadnaught.
- Cheat: c_mainGod – base has 99999999999999 health.
- Cheat: c_fowgone – removes fog of war.
- Cheat: c_richaf – Gives 999999999 of each resource.
- Cheat: c_popgrow – gives 9999 of each population.
- Cheat: c_cash – gives 99999 of each resource
.

notes.title: Update 1.3 (Menu Conquest) - Changlog
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.3.0 (menu conquest)[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34780659/25ce57a2b506c58a6345d9845ee11add0b5245e7.png[/img]
[h1]Additions[/h1]
-	Changelog menu revamp
-	Localization addition
-	Language menu
-	Menu effects
-	Game mode menu revamp
-	Survival menu revamp
-	Help menu revamp
-	Galaxy log
-	Colour picker revamp
-	Intro menu revamp
-	Main menu revamp
-	Asteroid event
-	Random event revamp
-	Outpost frigate spawn event (spawns a frigate from a random outpost over time, depending on difficulty chosen)
-	Fighter model revamp
-	Interceptor model revamp
-	Bomber model revamp
-	Main menu music
-	Ship builder music
-	Income display (each income tick)
-	Mines now display income additions
-	Fabricators now display income additions
-	Schools now display income additions
-	College now display income additions
-	Game Over Screen Rework
-	Auto Leave Game mover after 60 seconds
-	Alien wave inbound warning system
[h1]Changes[/h1]
-	Menu (whole thing)
-	Alien fighter balancing (health and shield reduction)
-	Alien frigate balancing (health and shield reduction)
-	Alien destroyer (health and shield reduction)
-	Alien cruiser (health and shield reduction)
-	Alien battleship (health and shield reduction)
-	Pirate fighter (health and shield reduction)
-	Pirate frigate (health and shield reduction)
-	Pirate destroyer (health and shield reduction)
-	Pirate cruiser (health and shield reduction)
-	Pirate leadership (health and shield reduction)
-	Pirate random event changed (pirate leadership now spawns after 10 minutes at a random pirate outpost)
-	Random event timer and spawn location.
-	Settings working throughout the game
-	Settings sound effects works.
-	Ships name’s now display names rather than class.
-	Upgraded from unity 2018 – 2019.1
-	Unity garbage collection – incremental garbage collection (should increase fps)
-	Optimised fow system, (increase in fps)
-	Colour picker system rework (correct settings applied expandable)
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
-	Sounds no longer 100% for 1 second after lunch
-	Fixed turret rotation speeds
-	Fixed pirate spawn rate
-	Fixed menu headers
-	Fixed menu overhead
-	Fixed player frigate collisions
-	Fixed player destroyer collisions
-	Fixed player fighter collisions
-	Fog of war values not being the same as the range
-	Settings buttons for links now work
-	Alien Wave counter reacts with timer.
